source: Shannon's new starter expectations (28 Oct 2026). Where they differ from the Sales Training Presentation's weeks 1 to 6 roadmap, or the KPI section of the general sales policy, this plan wins (decision 4a).

stages.title: Day 1
activities: First training session with John or Lucy, using the Sales Training Presentation
Shadow members of the team on live calls
Read the knowledge base pages for your first service

stages.title: Day 2
stages.expectation: Final call training, then half a day on the phone. No sales expected.
activities: Final call training with John or Lucy

stages.title: Day 3
stages.expectation: A full day on the phone. No sales expected, but good calls.
activities: Use the call scripts and objection handling in the knowledge base

stages.title: Days 4 and 5
stages.expectation: Full days on the phone, with a first sale of any size.

stages.title: Week 2
stages.expectation: A sale every day, and some consistency.
activities: Aim for a sale every day

stages.title: Week 3
stages.expectation: Building to an average of 5 stars a day.
activities: Build towards 5 stars a day on average

stages.title: Week 4
activities: Get close to target 1 each day

stages.title: Month 2
stages.expectation: As close to your own target 1 as possible.
activities: From your 21st working day you count towards your team's average stars

stages.title: Month 3
stages.expectation: Hitting target 1, or on track for it.
activities: Hit target 1, or be on track for it
